observed_advice_rule: hypothesis 2 = replacement by the non-gold entity, labeled contradiction.

primary_task_source.location: Section3.2, WSC paragraph, page6 of PDF; footnote2
facts: WSC is a coreference task; SuperGLUE represents a marked pronoun/candidate noun as a binary classification.
The paper describes related WNLI but does not supply universal three-way NLI labels for arbitrary full-sentence replacements.
The paper discusses train/dev sentence reuse in earlier WNLI and removes shared exact sentences in its WSC splits.
primary_task_source.wording_scope: These source facts are paraphrased; the task-conversion concerns below are reviewer logical analysis.

core_findings.finding: A false source coreference annotation does not establish contradiction of the entire substituted sentence.
core_findings.warrant: The official Mark/Pete witness permits both a gold-resolved source passage and its non-gold replacement sentence to be true. The universal contradiction conversion fails.
core_findings.required_action: Do not use source false as official contradiction. Preserve source annotations and record any analyst-created NLI labels separately.

core_findings.finding: False coreference also does not, by itself, prove that every full substituted sentence is not entailed.
core_findings.warrant: Reference identity and proposition truth conditions are distinct; other passage clauses or shared properties can independently entail a non-gold replacement.
core_findings.required_action: Audit each sampled conversion for entailment/nonentailment, not merely source-label agreement. Mark unresolved cases uncertain; freeze eligibility before candidate predictions.

core_findings.finding: The original unresolved-pronoun premise does not have a wholly unambiguous logical interpretation without a contextual/pragmatic coreference convention.
core_findings.warrant: WSC intentionally relies on commonsense to choose a referent. Treating the source gold as a logical axiom changes the evidence available.
core_findings.required_action: For the faithful-advice arm, keep the original premise and explicitly declare contextual/common-sense reading plus item-level ambiguity checks. A gold-resolved premise may be a separate semantic-control arm; do not silently substitute it as the literal Q48 protocol.

core_findings.finding: Gold-resolving the premise makes the positive full-text replacement identical or nearly identical to its premise, changing task difficulty.
core_findings.warrant: This isolates compatibility/label scoring but no longer measures the original model role-tracking challenge.
core_findings.required_action: Label this as a scoped constructed control. Never compare its scores to unreplaced-premise scores as a pure scoring-only intervention; pure scoring contrasts must hold exact predictions and inputs fixed.

core_findings.finding: Pronoun replacement can be ungrammatical or change semantics through possession, agreement, scope, or span errors.
core_findings.warrant: A possessive pronoun such as his cannot generally be replaced by a bare candidate noun. Only the annotated span should change.
core_findings.required_action: Use a prospectively defined morphology policy or a nominative-only source filter plus item-level grammar validation. Store original offsets and exact edits.

core_findings.finding: Multiple source records may share the same passage and schema variants may be related.
core_findings.warrant: The authentic witness already has two records for the same passage. Source row counts overstate independent units.
core_findings.required_action: Group exact passage duplicates and identifiable schema families before selection/confirmation allocation. Bootstrap shared source units jointly across models and hypotheses; report residual template dependence.

core_findings.finding: A larger repaired-binary score alone follows mechanically from accepting neutral on negatives.
core_findings.warrant: Holding positives fixed, repaired minus bad accuracy equals the fraction of negative items predicted neutral when those negatives are validated nonentailment.
core_findings.required_action: Treat score inflation/penalty as a descriptive consequence, not proof of novel model ranking harm. A ranking/selection claim needs fixed candidates, all pairwise outcomes, strict tie rules, and separate validated target confirmation.

recommended_primary_comparison.inputs: One preregistered, semantically audited original-pronoun premise and gold/non-gold full replacement pair per unique source passage; neutral/contradiction/entailment task definitions common across candidates. Cases unresolved by the agreed convention stay outside decisive primary scoring and in a visible accounting table.
recommended_primary_comparison.bad_rule: Gold candidate must be entailment; non-gold candidate must be contradiction. Neutral is incorrect. This faithfully operationalizes the documented bad rule.
recommended_primary_comparison.repaired_rule: On audited positive entailments, require entailment. On audited nonentailments, accept neutral or contradiction, without pretending the source supplied official three-way gold. If item-level three-way truth is independently justified, report it as a separate author-annotated analysis.
recommended_primary_comparison.passage_pair_score: Require both positive and negative decisions correct, matching the advice role-swap notion; individual-pair accuracy can be secondary. Keep denominators equal across scoring rules.
recommended_primary_comparison.selection: Fixed candidate configurations and strict unique winners chosen on a source-family-separated selection half; no arbitrary tie-break. Report all candidates, all ties and every pairwise rank change.
recommended_primary_comparison.confirmation: For any distinct unique choices, compare those fixed choices on an independently audited confirmation half under the repaired target rule. Preserve zero, negative and positive target differences.
recommended_primary_comparison.no_reversal: Report a null ranking/choice outcome; do not add candidates/items or search subsets until a crossing appears.
recommended_primary_comparison.minimum_size: A goal of40–80unique source passages is reasonable for a bounded pilot, but effective unit is schema family and size alone does not guarantee meaningful impact or representative validity.

minimum_pre_score_semantic_packet_fields: source_release/member/line/idx, original raw record SHA256 and exact passage SHA256
all corresponding positive/negative source records and original annotation meanings
target pronoun and candidate spans/offsets; exact replacement operation and morphology policy
original-pronoun premise, gold replacement hypothesis, non-gold replacement hypothesis
positive relation label/uncertainty, non-gold relation label/uncertainty, entailment witness or counterworld
why contradiction is or is not justified, rather than only reference disagreement
unresolved pronoun reading, scope/negation/quantifier/possession ambiguity notes
exact-passage group and schema-family group; later selection/confirmation role hidden from semantic reviewers
initial reviewer IDs/independent judgments and separate adjudication; candidate identities/predictions hidden
claim_bounds: The data remain authentic WSC source passages; the new NLI recast and semantic judgments are analyst-created and require human review for a human-validated claim.
A repaired binary score is an operational nonentailment target, not a validated three-way NLI benchmark score.
A held-out confirmation result is conditional on selected source/data conventions and fixed candidate aliases, not real-user harm or general model ranking.
A scoring-only contrast can isolate the effect of changing the score rule on fixed predictions. It does not identify the effect of adopting advice across research workflows.
No old PAWS gate is reused; this is a separately motivated protocol for a different observed label-conversion mechanism.
recommended_gate_before_inference: Pinned source bytes and deterministic model-blind candidate-item selection are complete.
All primary item conversions have independent semantic review or are flagged unresolved before predictions; original source and author labels are separate.
Source-group split, fixed candidates/controls, exact payloads, scoring/tie/missing rules and intended claim/effect thresholds are prospectively frozen.
Only model-facing task strings are transmitted; no source names, original gold labels, correct candidate indicators or semantic audit keys.
